children: With the political debate in Australia swinging toward sharply cutting immigration, business groups have warned that the idea risks damaging the economy. The One Nation party's proposal to radically cut the migrant intake by 750,000 over three years would be an act of self harm given significant labor and skills shortages, says Innes Willox, Chief Executive of the Australian Industry Group. Australia needs to remain open to global talent and ensure it is not seen as an insular nation turning its backs on the rest of world, Willox adds. (james.glynn@wsj.com; X @JamesGlynnWSJ)
